Title: Gaia DR3 slow-Vgrf catalogue, Tier A
Authors: Humble R.
Table: Tier A (P(Vgrf<25 km/s)>0.95) kinematics and chemistry. Tier membership uses the population-prior corrected score

Byte-by-byte Description of file: table.dat

 Bytes Format Units  Label     Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1- 19  I19      ---    source_id                Gaia DR3 source identifier

                                               ascension

                                               declination
